Comment.Language: For Saturdays and Sundays of the Great Fast:

Text.Language: V/e~tafern/cteuin e~h~r/i e~jwn n~h~me n~e~hoou nem h~me n~e~jwrh: sa n~tefcotten qen nennobi: Cw] m~mon ouoh nai nan.
who fasted for us forty days and forty nights until He saved us from our sins. Save us and have mercy on us.
الذي صام عنا أربعين يوماً وأربعين ليلة حتى خلصنا من خطايانا. خَلِّصْنا وارحَمْنا.
